question: Should this issue wait for a redacted current-main MiMo Discord payload capture before maintainers accept any broad hidden-reasoning filter or duplicate it into the MiniMax leak thread?
rationale: The report is security-sensitive, but current source can explain multiple different leak boundaries and a broad sanitizer has meaningful false-positive risk without raw payload evidence.

options.title: Require MiMo payload proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or reporter captures provider deltas, transcript blocks, and outbound Discord payload from current main, then choose the narrow fix layer.

options.title: Fold into the MiniMax leak thread
options.body: Treat the symptom as covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96849 and its candidate PR, accepting that MiMo-specific evidence may be lost.

options.title: Approve a broad delivery sanitizer
options.body: Let a repair attempt filter plain-English monologue at delivery time, accepting the risk of suppressing legitimate user-visible prose across providers.

recommendation.title: Require MiMo payload proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or reporter captures provider deltas, transcript blocks, and outbound Discord payload from current main, then choose the narrow fix layer.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and related PRs place this handle closest to both Discord reasoning delivery and OpenAI-compatible reasoning parsing.
